cases.title: Start-up smoke: About CE Suite names Civil, Structural and Manager at the installed versions with nothing "Not loaded"; CDCHECK prints its totals; the Civil log is written; nothing changes
cases.plan_item: Start-up smoke after the C-78 install (CASE_BRIEF_C78_N33_EXCEL_36 section E); routes of accepted cases R06 (About CE Suite) and R21 (CDCHECK)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from cases R06 and R21 and LoggingService.cs at 7c6af57b; not compared with a run.
cases.expected: At the start no CE window is open. CE_VERSION opens "About CE Suite", whose text shows Civil Suite v<installed Civil>, Structural Suite v<installed Structural>, Suite Manager v<installed Manager>, and no "Not loaded" or "CONFLICT"; Close shuts it. CDCHECK with Enter prints "[CE] CDCHECK: <n> objects, <m> connections ..." and Esc ends it; the Civil log gains a "Command outcome: CDCHECK" line; no line says "Unknown command"; the object count and the drawing file on disk are unchanged; no CE window is left open.
cases.why_not_unit: Only a real AutoCAD start shows that the installed bundle loads all three products and that a CE command runs in it.
not_automated: The ribbon tabs (CE, CE STRUC, CE Tools) are not read: the AutoCAD main window is on the driver's never-read list. A Codex look sees them.
The Civil log's "CE_CVL_SUITE v... Started" line is not asserted: it is written before the case's log start (see header item 2). The installed version is recorded instead.
